identity_mother_prompt.rule: This prompt and the locked V9 output define character identity. Later prompts inherit its identity constraints and name only their delta.

pair.shape: matched upright solid black vertical ovals
pair.body: continuous filled black silhouette; no changed eye type across emotion or direction

interior_white.rule: Both white marks remain inside the black eye body. The sparkle is an identity anchor, not an emotion or direction channel.
interior_white.scale: The primary reflection stays compact in the upper half and may not read as a white cap, lower half, ring, or large empty cutout. The diamond stays materially smaller than the primary reflection.
interior_white.eye_body_scale: All open-eye pairs retain the locked V9 cell-normalized optical scale and generous surrounding whitespace; no enlarged kawaii-eye treatment.

forbidden: hollow lower eye or lower white half-moon
eye-body resize, rotation, warp or side-eye
downward half-lid, drooping, sad, romantic or deep-looking eye
eyelashes or any black eyelid arc touching/hugging the eye

expression_channels.direction_channel: the existing primary reflection may change registered in-eye position only after a candidate has passed component extraction; it must not change the eye body
expression_channels.coordination_rule: A named emotion needs at least brows plus mouth or cheeks in addition to any charm; a charm alone is not an emotion.
expression_channels.transition_rule: Later previews must transform named source components through entry, hold and settle. A source contact-sheet cell is an anchor, never an animation frame.

daily_attention.meaning: attention direction only, not four different emotions
daily_attention.required_readability: visibly distinct primary-reflection placement plus coordinated brow/mouth/cheek response at thumbnail scale

pose_program.unavailable_state_policy: fail_closed; no ordinary face borrowing or art export

prompt_protocol.parent_reference: Every generation supplies the locked V9 image as the sole render reference. Rejected candidates are evidence only and must never be supplied as visual reference.
prompt_protocol.delta_rule: One candidate generation may change only one named scope: pose program, eye-readability refinement, mouth/brow detail, or detached charm vocabulary. It cannot silently alter identity anchors.

forbids: V1 or rejected candidate component export
